chapter.verse: Pasian' deihna tawh Khris Jesu' sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Timothy in
Colossae khua-a om, Khris sunga mi siangthote leh a citak sanggamte, kong hopih uh hi. Note' tungah i Pa ahi Pasian' kiangpan hehpihna leh nopna lemna hong tung ta hen.
Note' ading thu ka nget uh ciangin i Topa Jesu Khris ii Pa ahi Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung uh hi.
A hang pen Khris Jesu na upna uh leh mi siangtho khempeuh na itna uh ka na za khinzo uh hi.
Tua bangin upna itna na neih uh pen thumaan thutak Lungdamna Thu hong kigen lai-a na zak uh, note' adinga vantung ah a kikoihkhol, lametna thu hang ahi hi.

Note' kiangah tua thu hong tun ciangin na zak ni uh, Pasian' hehpihna maantak na theihtel ni uh-a kipan note' lakah gahleteh hong neih mah bangin leitung bup ah zong gahleteh nei-in a pung a khang ahi hi.
Note' taangin Khris' nasem a muanhuai khat ahi, ka it uh kote' silapih Epaphras' tungpan tua thu na theihkhak uh hi a,
Kha Siangtho sunga om note' itna thu zong ama' hong gen mah ahi hi.

Tua hi a, hih thu ka zak ni uh-a kipan ko zong tatsat lo-in thu kong ngetsak uh hi. Ka thunget uh pen note in kha sung pilna leh theihtelna khempeuh tawh ama' deihna thu a cingin na theih nading uh hi a,

tua hileh Topa' zia tawh kituakin gamta thei-in na khempeuh ah amah a lungkimsak na suah nading uh ahi hi. Tua bang i cih ciangin nahoih sepna namkim ah gahleteh nei-in Pasian theihna ah a cingtaak a khanglian na hih nading uh ahi zongin,
lungdamna tawh a tawp dongin lungduai thuakzo-in ama' minpha ukzawhna tungtawnin vangliatna citeng tawh a thadim na hih nading uh ahi zongin,
khuavak sungah mi siangthote' gamh a luahkhawm thei dingin a tehcing hong suaksak Pa' tungah hehpihna a phat na hih nading uh, cih thute kihel hi.
Tua Pasian in khuamial ukna huam sungpan eite hong honkhia-in a it ama' Tapa' kumpigam sungah phual hong tuansak hi.
Tua Tapa' hangin mawhmaina ahi tatkhiatna thupha i ngah hi.
Amah pen muhtheihloh Pasian' limlemel hi a, piansakna bup ma-a om tacil ahi hi.

A hang pen ama' hangin na khempeuh a kipiangsak hi a, na khempeuh—vantung leh leitunga om, muhtheih muhmawh, kumpi-tokhomte ahi-a tote mangte, gam-uk uliante leh ukna thuneite ahi zongin, na khempeuh—ama' tungtawn leh ama' adingin a kipiangsak ahi hi.
Na khempeuh a om ma-in amah om a, ama' sungah na khempeuh kibuptuah hi.
Amah pen pawlpi ahi pumpi ii lutang hi a, na khempeuh ah a thupipen ahih nadingin kipatna bulpi leh misite' lakpan tacil zong ahi hi.
A hang pen Pasian in ama' cingtaakna bup Tapa' sungah teengsak ding cih thu leh
tua Tapa tungtawnin leitung vantunga om na khempeuh tawh a kilemkik theih nadingin Tapa' singlamteh sisan tawh kilemna bawl ding cih thu, lungkimtak khensat hi.
Tua hi a, hun khat lai-in Pasian tawh a kidangsuah, siat gamtatna hangin lungsim sungpan a kigalneih note pen
tu-in Pasian' mai-ah a siangtho, sitbaanglo leh kawkbaanglo na suah theih nadingun Tapa in sihna tungtawnin ama' cilesa pumpi sungah note hong lemtuah khin hi.

Tua hi a, vanpi nuai-a om piansakna bup ah a kitangko khin thu, keimah Paul zong tua' adingin nasem khat ka suahna thu ahi, na zaksa uh Lungdamna Thu, tua thu tawh a kizom lametna pan pialkhia kha lo-in upna sungah kiptak khotak na omzom ding uh ahi hi.
Tu-in note' taangin ka gimthuakna ah ka lungdam hi. Hih pen Khris' gimnate' sunga a kisam lai thute, pawlpi ahi Khris pumpi' taangin keima' pumpi tawh a dipsak ka hi hi.
Note' adinga kei hong kipia Pasian' innsung thuvanna dung zui-in pawlpi nasem khat ka suak a, tua pen Pasian' thu a cingsak ding nasep ahi hi.
Tua Pasian' thu pen khanghun tampi leh khangsawn tampi sung a kiseelcip thusim hi a, tu-in ama' mi siangthote' tungah kipholak ta hi.
Pasian in hih thusim, note' sunga om Khris, minpha lametna thu, Gentile mite' lakah minphatna tawh kidim ahihlam mi siangthote theisak nuam hi.
Tua hi a, kote in Khris' kiangah mi khempeuh a picingin ka tunpih theih nadingun pilna a namkim tawh mi khempeuh lamlakin mi khempeuh taaibawlin Khris' thu ka tangko uh hi.
Tua dingin nasep ka hahkat a, ka sungah khauhtakin a gamtang ama' vangliatna tawh hihtheihtawp ka pang hi.
